claims.text: PFAS transfer to container walls during sampling, storage or experiments is an important source of error in PFAS analysis.
Data that justify the usual polyethylene and polypropylene container choices are sparse.
You have studied how PFAS structure affects oxidation in a boron-doped diamond electrochemical system.

evidence_texts.text: Mass transfer of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) to container walls during sample collection and storage or experimentation is an important source of error in PFAS analysis.
